Class HuntingBoard

java.lang.Object
hunting.HuntingBoard
public class HuntingBoard extends Object
A model class that manages the overall state of the game board, character positions, movement validation, turn counters, and win conditions.

  • Constructor Details

    • HuntingBoard

      public HuntingBoard(int boardSize)
      Constructs a HuntingBoard instance with the specified grid dimension. Initializes the grid array, maximum allowable turns (4 * boardSize), and starting positions.
      Parameters:
      boardSize - the size of one side of the square board (n x n).

  • Method Details

    • handleTileClick

      public boolean handleTileClick(int r, int c)
      Handles user clicks on a specified grid tile. Performs character selection or movement validation depending on whose turn it currently is.
      Parameters:
      r - the row index of the clicked tile.
      c - the column index of the clicked tile.
      Returns:
      true if a move or selection was successfully executed; false otherwise.

    • isOver

      public boolean isOver()
      Checks if the game has ended. The game ends if the Fugitive has no legal moves left or the turn limit is reached.
      Returns:
      true if the game is over; false otherwise.

    • getWinnerMessage

      public String getWinnerMessage()
      Generates a result message announcing the winner of the game.
      Returns:
      a message String declaring the winner, or an empty string if the game is ongoing.
